evidence.source_locator: p. 8 Table 2, I-1 column; pp. 7-8 section C and Fig. 10
evidence.pass_criterion: Reported propagating thin-fuel flame with finite steady size
evidence.notes: Exposed length 940 mm; duct height 460 mm. Width/length converted from cm. Thickness and external heat flux unresolved; BASS thickness not transferred. This is a spread observation, not an oxygen limit. Concurrent direction corroborated by NTRS 20180005168 presentation p. 30 Table 1 (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20180005168/downloads/20180005168.pdf). Report section C also discusses subsequent opposed spread. Human review required.
